run_elevater_eval_sweep: run the elevater evaluation sweep across multiple models and shot settings using submitit
run_main: run the main function to launch elevater eval jobs on a SLURM cluster
create_CLIPEvalConfig: create a CLIPEvalConfig with elevater shot settings and lora weight location for a model
submit_CLIPEvalJob: submit a CLIPEvalJob via submitit AutoExecutor with SLURM parameters for GPU evaluation
toggle_DO_FULL: toggle the DO_FULL flag to switch between partial-shot and full dataset evaluation sweeps
